node.label: Increased level of ribitol in urine
node.definition: An increase in the level of ribitol in the urine. Ribotol is a crystalline pentose alcohol (C5H12O5) and is a metabolic end product formed by the reduction of ribose.

evidence.snippet: Ribose 5-phosphate isomerase deficiency: Increased level of ribitol in urine [PCS]
